title: Organic vs Paid Cannibalization Analysis
deck: Some installs attributed to paid ads would have arrived organically anyway. Without measuring and correcting for this, ROAS is overestimated.
summary: Cannibalization is paid advertising eating into organic installs. The two standard ways to measure true incremental installs are (1) Geo Holdout experiments and (2) Causal Impact modeling. Large ad channels need an incrementality measurement once a quarter.

content.html: The share of observed paid installs that is truly incremental: iROAS = incremental_revenue / cost. The wider the gap between regular ROAS and iROAS, the higher the cannibalization share.

rows: Only revenue that wouldn't exist without the ad

items: Split countries/regions into two groups (Treatment / Control), matched on population and revenue share.
Treatment keeps ads running as usual; Control turns the network/campaign OFF.
Run 2–4 weeks, then measure the install/revenue gap between groups.

content.html: Where GeoX turns ads off by region, Holdout excludes a share of users from ad exposure. It's the fallback when GeoX is impossible in single-region operations (e.g. Korea only). Meta, Google, and TikTok all offer campaign-level holdouts.
A holdout group that's too small can't reach statistical significance. In general:

items: Minimum holdout size: at ~1,000 installs/day, a holdout share of 30%+ is recommended
Duration: at least 4 weeks (to remove day-of-week effects) — observe through D14 revenue
Use each network's built-in power calculators (Meta Conversion Lift, Google Lift Study)

content.title: 3.3 GeoX vs Holdout — how to choose

rows: Brands with heavy TV/OOH offline media

items: Compute iROAS / ROAS per network (the Lift Factor)
Multiply every network's ROAS by its Lift Factor before comparing (raw ROAS isn't comparable across networks)
Typical industry Lift Factors: Meta UA ≈ 0.7–0.8, Google UAC ≈ 0.6–0.75, ASA Brand ≈ 0.3–0.5 (brand terms cannibalize heavily)
Re-measure Lift Factors every 6 months — traffic quality and market conditions shift

content.label: Per-network Lift Factor application

content.title: Organic in the Control group is also affected
content.html: Brand awareness campaigns leak into other regions (TV, out-of-home). GeoX only isolates digital channels. Mass brand campaigns need a separate holdout window (nationwide OFF).

content.title: Results are at noise level
content.html: Below roughly 5,000 installs/week or $50,000+/week revenue, significance is hard to reach. For small campaigns use Causal Impact (time-series modeling) instead of GeoX.

content.title: Revenue in the holdout group is normal
content.html: Don't misread this — turning ads off doesn't zero out revenue. Organic, returning users, and other networks keep baseline revenue flowing. The true effect is the gap: incremental = test_revenue − control_revenue.

content.title: How to feed lift results back into bidding
content.html: Reallocate budget by iROAS. Never fully kill a low-Lift-Factor network (e.g. ASA Brand at 0.35) — brand keywords also block competitor intrusion, a value beyond ROI. Adjust the share instead.
